sentences.text:
2023 
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice C. V. Bhaskar Reddy
 Writ Petition No.31378 Of 2023
 Order:

The writ petition is filed seeking following relief:
"......to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of writ of Mandamus questioning the action of respondents more particularly respondent No. 3 herein in not considering the documents presented by the petitioner for filing of the charge sheet as illegal, arbitrary, unjust and violative of articles 14, 19 and 21 and against the principles of natural justice and consequently direct the respondents to consider the documents presented by the petitioner and file charge sheet in accordance with law in the interest of justice......"

2. It is the case of the petitioner that a case in Crime No.203 of 2023 was registered against her for the offences punishable under Sections 417, 420, 376 and 312 of IPC and she was arrayed as accused No.4.

It is the further case of the petitioner that false cases have been foisted against her and she is having all the material to satisfy that there is no involvement of her in the above said crime and the respondents-police without considering the documents have registered the said crime, therefore,
prays this Court to direct the respondents to consider the documents presented by her before laying the charge sheet.
3.

Learned Assistant Government Pleader for Home appearing for respondent Nos.1 and 2 submits that acting on the complaint of the victim, the respondents-police have conducted investigation and laid charge sheet before the Judicial First Class Magistrate, Khammam and the same is pending for allotting the PRC Number.

4. Since the respondents-police have already completed the investigation and laid charge sheet against the petitioner, the petitioner is at liberty to file appropriate application before the concerned Court for filing the documents in accordance with law.
5. With the above observations, this writ petition is disposed of.
As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending shall stand closed.
C.V. BHASKAR REDDY, J Date: 14.11.2023 sus
